title: Security Policy
text: latest minor release main receives security fixes. Upgrade latest version reporting issue.

title: Security Policy
text: file public GitHub issue security vulnerabilities. Report privately via one : GitHub private vulnerability reporting (preferred): go Security tab click “Report vulnerability” Email: security@datacore.vn (PGP required; use subject line “datacore-r security”) Include much following possible: Description vulnerability potential impact Steps reproduce proof--concept Affected versions Suggested fix, one acknowledge receipt within 2 business days aim release fix within 14 days critical issues.

title: Security Policy
text: Issues scope include: API key leakage insufficient masking logs/output Authentication bypass Dependency vulnerabilities clear exploit path scope: theoretical issues practical exploit path, issues test fixtures mocked data.

title: Getting started with datacore
text: datacore official R client DataCore, Vietnamese financial alternative data platform. built feel like native tidyverse package: every endpoint returns tibble, dates real Date objects, client respects rate limits retries transparently. vignette walks : Installation Setting API key Searching catalog Browsing domains products Pulling VN30 daily prices

title: Getting started with datacore
code: # install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("DataCore-VietNam/datacore-r")

title: Getting started with datacore
text: Get key https://datacore.vn set environment variable. recommended place ~/.Renviron: Restart R session ’re ready. can also pass key explicitly one-scripts: everything ’ll assume environment variable set:
code: DATACORE_API_KEY=dc_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx library(datacore) dc <- datacore_client(api_key = "dc_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx") library(datacore) dc <- datacore_client() dc #> <datacore_client> #>   base_url: https://api.datacore.vn/v1 #>   timeout:  30s #>   api_key:  dc_l************xxxx

title: Getting started with datacore
code: hits <- dc_search(dc, "VN30 fundamentals", limit = 5) hits #> # A tibble: 5 x 4 #>   id                    name                 domain product #>   <chr>                 <chr>                <chr>  <chr> #> 1 equity.vn30.daily     VN30 Daily Prices    equity vn30 #> 2 equity.vn30.fund      VN30 Fundamentals    equity vn30 #> ...

title: Getting started with datacore
code: dc_list_domains(dc) #> # A tibble: 4 x 3 #>   id          name                 description #>   <chr>       <chr>                <chr> #> 1 equity      Equities             Vietnamese listed equities #> 2 macro       Macro & Economy      GSO, GDP, CPI, IIP #> 3 fx          Foreign Exchange     SBV reference rates #> 4 fixed-income Fixed Income        Government & corporate bonds  dc_list_products(dc, "equity")

title: Getting started with datacore
text: Filter tickers:
code: library(dplyr)  vn30 <- dc_get(   dc,   "equity.vn30.daily",   start = "2024-01-01",   end   = "2024-12-31" )  vn30 |>   group_by(symbol) |>   summarise(     obs       = n(),     last_date = max(date),     last_px   = last(close)   ) focus <- dc_get(   dc,   "equity.vn30.daily",   start   = "2024-01-01",   symbols = c("VNM", "VIC", "VHM") )

title: Getting started with datacore
text: dc_schema(dc, "equity.vn30.daily") column-level documentation dc_sample(dc, "equity.vn30.daily") quick preview DataCore cookbook end--end examples (factor models, event studies, Tidy Finance VN)

what: datacore - Vietnamese Financial Data for R
title: datacore - Vietnamese Financial Data for R
text: Official R client DataCore – Vietnamese financial, alternative, economic data. Tibble-native, tidyverse-compatible, built-pagination, retry, rate-limit handling.

title: datacore - Vietnamese Financial Data for R
code: # CRAN (once available) install.packages("datacore")  # Latest development version from GitHub # install.packages("pak") pak::pak("DataCore-VietNam/datacore-r")

title: datacore - Vietnamese Financial Data for R
text: Get free API key datacore.vn/keys. Store environment never hardcoded:
code: # Recommended: add to ~/.Renviron (restart R after editing) usethis::edit_r_environ() # Add the line: DATACORE_API_KEY=dc_live_...  # Or set for the current session only Sys.setenv(DATACORE_API_KEY = "dc_live_...")

title: datacore - Vietnamese Financial Data for R
code: library(datacore)  dc <- datacore_client()   # reads DATACORE_API_KEY from environment  # Browse what is available dc_list_domains(dc) dc_search(dc, "VN30 daily")  # Pull VN30 daily prices for 2024 vn30 <- dc_collect(dc, "equity.vn30.daily",                    start = "2024-01-01",                    end   = "2024-12-31")  head(vn30)

title: datacore - Vietnamese Financial Data for R
code: dc_preview("equity.vn30.daily", n = 5)

title: datacore - Vietnamese Financial Data for R
code: dc <- datacore_client()  # One page (manual pagination) pg1 <- dc_get(dc, "equity.vn30.daily", start = "2024-01-01", page = 1L)  # All pages combined into one tibble vn30 <- dc_collect(dc, "equity.vn30.daily",                    start = "2024-01-01", end = "2024-12-31")  # Stream all pages directly to CSV (constant memory usage) dc_download(dc, "equity.vn30.daily",             output_path = "vn30_2024.csv",             start = "2024-01-01", end = "2024-12-31")

title: datacore - Vietnamese Financial Data for R
code: dc_list_domains(dc)                          # top-level domains dc_list_products(dc, "equity")               # products in a domain dc_list_datasets(dc, product = "vn30")       # datasets in a product dc_search(dc, "inflation monthly", limit = 5L)  dc_metadata(dc, "equity.vn30.daily")         # full metadata dc_schema(dc, "equity.vn30.daily")           # column-level schema as tibble dc_sample(dc, "equity.vn30.daily", n = 5)   # random sample rows

title: Create a DataCore API client — datacore_client
text: api_key Character. DataCore API key. NULL (default), environment variable DATACORE_API_KEY consulted. error raised neither set. base_url Character. Base URL API. Defaults public endpoint https://api.datacore.vn/v1. timeout Numeric. Per-request timeout seconds. Defaults 30.

title: Fetch all rows from a dataset, paginating automatically — dc_collect
text: client datacore_client created datacore_client(). dataset_id Character. dataset id, e.g. "equity.vn30.daily". start Optional. Start date (inclusive). Date, POSIXt, "yyyy-mm-dd" string. end Optional. End date (inclusive). symbols Optional. Character vector ticker symbols filter . limit Integer. Rows per page. Defaults 100L. max_rows Integer NULL. Stop many rows. NULL (default) fetches everything. verbose Logical. Print progress line per page. Defaults interactive(). ... Additional named arguments passed query parameters.

title: Fetch all rows from a dataset, paginating automatically — dc_collect

title: datacore 0.1.0
text: datacore_client(): construct authenticated API client key masking validation dc_get(): fetch single page rows dataset dc_collect(): auto-paginate return rows single tibble dc_download(): stream pages CSV file constant memory usage dc_preview(): preview dataset rows without API key dc_search(): free-text search across catalog dc_list_domains(), dc_list_products(), dc_list_datasets(): browse catalog hierarchy dc_metadata(), dc_schema(), dc_sample(): inspect individual datasets Tibble-native output, tidyverse-compatible Retry 5xx 429 responses Retry-support Classed error hierarchy (datacore_auth_error, datacore_not_found_error, datacore_rate_limit_error, datacore_server_error, datacore_api_error)
